changeSet.author: your-name
changeSet.comment: Enforce one row per (quote_id, edp_id). A duplicate estimate callback previously inserted a second set of rows for the same quote, which let two access tokens be issued (the second expiring the first). The unique constraint lets a concurrent duplicate INSERT conflict instead of succeeding, so only one callback issues a token and emails the link.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM quote_edp_results a USING quote_edp_results b WHERE a.quote_id = b.quote_id AND a.edp_id = b.edp_id AND a.id > b.id;
